summary: v4 frontend-only re-test of 2 minor bugs flagged in iteration_3 on /sparks (AffiliateHub). Both fixes verified PASS. (1) copy-link and copy-code buttons no longer surface 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay — wrapped in try/catch with isSecureContext guard + Promise.resolve + document.execCommand fallback. Toasts 'Link copied' and 'Code copied' fire correctly (clipboard succeeded under HTTPS). Zero pageerrors, zero console errors observed during clicks. (2) period toggle (period-monthly/quarterly/annual) now drives BOTH the chart-card AND the separate stat-mtd card: stat-mtd .stat-label cycles 'THIS MONTH'->'THIS QUARTER'->'THIS YEAR', new testid stat-mtd-period cycles MTD->QTD->YTD, stat-mtd-amount reads from periodMap[period], and period-label (MONTH-TO-DATE/QUARTER-TO-DATE/YEAR-TO-DATE) + period-amount update in lock-step. Regression sweep: all 12 previously verified testids render (referral-link-card, copy-link, copy-code, stat-total-earned, stat-active-sparks, stat-mtd, stat-ytd, commission-chart-card, period-label, period-amount, sparks-list + 'Your Constellation' heading). New testids stat-mtd-amount and stat-mtd-period present and reactive.
critical_code_review_comments: copy() implementation in AffiliateHub.jsx is solid: checks window.isSecureContext, typeof navigator.clipboard.writeText==='function', wraps in Promise.resolve(...).catch(fallback), and outer try/catch falls back to execCommand. fallbackCopy itself is also wrapped in try/catch. This pattern should be extracted into /app/frontend/src/lib/clipboard.js if any other page needs copy-to-clipboard.
stat-mtd card now correctly derives from periodMap[period] state — single source of truth shared with period-amount in chart card. Good.
Stat 'stat-ytd' card to the right of stat-mtd still always shows YTD regardless of toggle — this is intentional (it's a fixed YTD anchor while stat-mtd is the toggled view); no action needed.

Test ran against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://reellab-backoffice.preview.emergentagent.com over HTTPS so navigator.clipboard.writeText succeeded; fallbackCopy path was not exercised but the guard logic (window.isSecureContext + typeof check + try/catch) ensures no overlay even when clipboard API throws. To force-test fallback, monkey-patch navigator.clipboard to throw before clicking copy-link.
